_comment: Sites in the cross-site rollup (tools/ga4-rollup.mjs). measurementId is the G- id the site ships; the numeric propertyId is looked up from it, or set propertyId to skip the lookup (all four are set; run ga4-rollup.mjs --discover to re-check them). 'match' is the text a session source must contain to count as coming from that site. Exactly one site is the hub whose project_click events are joined to arrivals on the others.
